verdict.rationale: Gladia's pre-recorded quickstart documents a Translation feature that translates the transcript into one of 100 target languages. The pricing page lists Translation as a billable add-on (+0.05€/h), which confirms it is a shipped API option. missing for 10: the exact request parameter or config shape for translation, evidence of translation in live/real-time sessions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of translation quality.
